query:
-- Fix TX Governor: D nominee is Gina Hinojosa (TX State Rep), not Vikki Goodwin
UPDATE governor_races SET
  dem_candidate = 'Gina Hinojosa',
  dem_previous_office = 'Texas House of Representatives (2017–present)',
  dem_bio = 'Texas State Representative serving since 2017. Attorney and advocate for public education and Texas families. Won the Democratic primary with 58.5% of the vote, defeating a crowded field.',
  status = 'Voting',
  notes = 'Greg Abbott (R) won the Republican primary with 81.8%. Gina Hinojosa (D) won the Democratic primary with 58.5%. General election November 3, 2026.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX';

-- Fix GA Governor: runoff is June 16, not July
UPDATE governor_races SET
  notes = 'R primary runoff (June 16, 2026): Burt Jones (Lt. Governor, Trump-endorsed) vs. Rick Jackson (billionaire businessman). Winner faces Keisha Lance Bottoms (D) in November.'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';
